notes.title: Puzzletrunk | An April Update
notes.content:
Greetings! It is our first Steam post for Puzzletrunk, as we start warming things up for our eventual Steam release. 

The Steam version is still being worked on. Alongside designing brand new puzzles, we are working back through the archives and fixing, iterating and polishing old ones. Puzzletrunk is developed at breakneck speeds on a very aggressive monthly timeline, and so we want to take the adequate time for the full Steam release to tighten up everything that's come before. 

Keen to play before then? Our (mostly) monthly puzzles are available via Itch, with our latest - Windows - having dropped just today. 

Solve it before 11.59 BST on April 27th and you can guarantee yourself a copy of Pantaloon's partnered game for April: Windowkill. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2726450/Windowkill/

In the meantime, if your brain is craving more puzzle-food, our psycological narrative puzzle game Sub-Verge launches on May 1st. The game has just been selected as an official title for LudoNarraCon 2025, and will be launching directly into the show. 

[previewyoutube=1JTZ2UCdKas;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487020/SubVerge/

We'll have more to share soon, but for now, let us know what you think of this month's puzzle, furnish us with any other feedback you might have, and please chuck the game a wishlist if you can - this helps us hugely. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158160/Puzzletrunk/
